cv.name: Olivia Sterling-Ross
cv.headline: Communications Manager | Corporate & Internal Comms | Charity and Housing
cv.summary: Communications manager with ten years in the housing association and charity sectors. I lead media relations, internal communications and crisis communications, and I write most of the difficult letters myself.

experience.title: Communications Manager
bullets: Lead a team of five across media, digital and internal communications for 28,000 homes
Managed communications during a damp and mould review, including resident letters and press enquiries
Launched a staff intranet used by 1,100 colleagues, replacing weekly email bulletins
Advise the executive team on reputation and regulatory announcements

experience.title: Senior Communications Officer
bullets: Secured national coverage for two fundraising campaigns

experience.title: Press Officer
bullets: Wrote press releases and managed journalist relationships for exhibitions
